Level 200 to 300 and 300 to 400 — minimum CWA 50%, accumulate at least 24 credits per year, no more than 9 failed credits in one academic year or 12 credits across years. Degree classification: CWA 80%+ earns First Class; 70%+ earns Second Class Upper; 60%+ earns Second Class Lower; 50%+ earns Pass.
keywords: minimum, cwa, progress, through, acity, engineering, programmes, exams, year, level
source: Student Handbook 2025 — Sections 2.3.2, 2.3.4, 2.3.7

question: What happens if a student abandons their programme without formally withdrawing from ACity?
answer: A student who absents themselves from all courses for a semester examination without proper permission is deemed to have abandoned the programme, triggering automatic withdrawal and loss of student status. Students needing time off must formally defer by writing to the Registrar before the semester begins.
